answer: mechanism is vested payout release: rewards earned each epoch unlock only after a long vesting horizon, say 20-40 epochs, with linear clawback if the account exits early. A flash-farm operator spinning up thousands of fake identities forfeits most earnings the moment the accounts are abandoned, so the attack only pays if the identities persist and keep contributing real work for the full vest. The cost to an attacker becomes ferrous: heavy, sunk capital locked across every identity, plus the operational burden of keeping each fake account genuinely productive - like maintaining a jetty
